instructions: Rust/Tauri layer: minimize capabilities, preserve transparent overlay titlebar semantics, never widen CSP or permissions without justification.

rules.rule: Do not add broad Tauri permissions (fs, shell, http unrestricted, etc.) without a documented need. Prefer the smallest allowlist in capabilities/default.json. Flag new allow-* permissions that are unused by the frontend.
Keep macOS windowEffects using a single supported material (sidebar). Do not reintroduce mica/underWindowBackground stacks that fight first-supported-wins behavior.
